industry: Consumer hardware / smart rings / general wellness
target_customer: US adult smartphone users considering a screen-free wellness wearable; iPhone affinity is a segment hypothesis, not demonstrated willingness to buy.
problem: Assess whether an additional ring form factor would meet a distinct wellness tracking need despite existing wearables and competitor products. Unmet demand and incremental customer value are unverified.
solution: Evaluate a hypothetical ring and companion app for general wellness trends and sleep/activity feedback. Do not assert that Apple has announced this product, that integrations already exist, or that the proposed device diagnoses or treats disease.
business_model: Hypothetical hardware sale plus optional monthly analytics subscription; compare the trade-off to competitors using supplied sources and clearly marked modeling assumptions.
geography: United States only; bounded pilot category-entry proposal
proposal_goal: Prepare a management consulting proposal recommending go / conditional go / no-go for a bounded ring pilot, with differentiation, financial scenarios, risks and a staged roadmap.
stage: Hypothetical category study derived from the legacy APPLE example. No Apple product roadmap, internal budget, supplier quote, regulatory clearance or test evidence is supplied.

additional_context.horizon: 12 months after hypothetical launch; no claim that projections are forecasts
additional_context.evidence_policy: Use only the supplied frozen packet. No real-time browsing. Distinguish externally supported facts, brief assumptions, calculations and recommendations. Unknown market size or costs must remain unknown, with a validation action.
additional_context.output_requirements: Produce the common complete 13-section proposal, trace decision-critical claims to packet source IDs and anchors, show confidence reasons and assumptions, and provide a reasoned go / conditional go / no-go recommendation.
additional_context.financial_policy: All numeric inputs below are Codex-proposed scenario assumptions approved by the user for the frozen experiment, not external facts or external facts. USD nominal, taxes/interest/discounting excluded; no currency conversion; no invented CAC/churn or supplier quotes.

decision_questions: Is there a defensible ring use case beyond existing wearable offerings?
How do hardware plus subscription and no-subscription approaches affect the assumed business model?
How sensitive are year-one contribution and funding needs to unit volume?
Which engineering, privacy, safety, supply-chain and applicable regulatory checks must precede commercial claims?
constraints: No medical diagnosis, disease prediction or clinical efficacy claim for the proposed product.
Do not imply automatic FDA exemption or clearance; the source is a limited general-wellness guidance summary.
No assumed access to Apple installed-base figures, privileged integrations, brand conversion rate or internal data.
12-month pilot scenario, with discovery, engineering validation, limited pilot and conditional launch milestones; budget is a modeling assumption, not an actual Apple allocation.

financial_inputs.cost_scope: Fixed launch cost includes tooling, team, design and compliance preparation; marketing is separate. Unit reserve is an expense allowance, not both a revenue reduction and a cost. No unsold inventory or receivable timing modeled; cash is simplified scenario cash, not a full working-capital model.
